scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-tally "pnpm --filter @tally/app exec vitest run src/sync/rules.test.ts"
scripts.e2e:cloud: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-tally "CLOUD_E2E=1 playwright test"
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @tally/web build && node scripts/vercel-output.mjs apps/web/out apps/web && npx --yes vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --cwd apps/web
scripts.deploy:storybook: pnpm --filter @tally/storybook build && node scripts/vercel-output.mjs apps/storybook/storybook-static apps/storybook && npx --yes vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --cwd apps/storybook
